hypotheses.G1_high_score_generalization: Hybrid-64 median top-mode effect correlation is at least 0.95 on high-score sites for every corpus.
hypotheses.G2_component_coverage: At least 14 of 16 components reach Hybrid-64 correlation at least 0.90 on high-score sites in every corpus.
hypotheses.G3_random_site_generalization: Hybrid-64 median effect correlation is at least 0.90 on random sites for every corpus.
hypotheses.G4_context_gain: Hybrid-64 improves median centered R2 over the 32D quotient by at least 0.20 in both strata on every corpus.
hypotheses.G5_hybrid128_calibration: Hybrid-128 median relative effect error is at most 0.10 in both strata on every corpus.
